name: What drywall finish level is recommended for basement walls and ceilings?

mainEntity.name: What drywall finish level is recommended for basement walls and ceilings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Level 4 finish with orange peel or knockdown texture is the most common and practical choice for finished basements. Textured surfaces diffuse basement lighting, disguise minor framing imperfections, and resist normal wear from family activities. A Level 5 finish is completely skim-coated flat, which is ideal if you plan to install glossy paint or strong accent lighting along long foundation walls, though it requires significantly more labor and time to achieve.
acceptedAnswer.description: A Level 4 finish with light texture is standard and durable for basements, while a smooth Level 5 finish is best under harsh accent lighting.
